name: My Toy ~Ojou-sama no Choukyou Nisshi~
original_name: マイトイ～お嬢様の調教日誌～
source:
Main character is training girls to fit specific requests.  His goal is not just produce a mindless doll, but to save individuality and feeling of shame. He considers it art.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角按照特定的要求调教女孩们。他的目标不只是制造一个没有思想的玩偶，而是保留个性和羞耻感。他认为这是一种艺术。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
